name: Dimdazenil
summary: Dimdazenil (EVT-201) is a benzodiazepine-derived hypnotic and partial positive allosteric modulator of GABA-A receptors, with relatively greater activity at receptors containing the alpha-1 subunit. Clinical studies have evaluated it for insomnia.
effectsSummary: Clinical trials reported improvements in sleep onset and sleep maintenance. It enhances GABA-A-mediated inhibitory signaling, producing hypnotic and sedative effects.
generalRisks: Clinical studies have reported dizziness, vertigo and weakness. Sedation and impaired alertness are possible. Alcohol, opioids and other central nervous system depressants may increase these risks.
longtermRisks: Long-term safety, tolerance and dependence risks remain insufficiently characterized. Regular use may carry risks of dependence and withdrawal.
saferUse: Avoid alcohol and combinations with opioids or other sedatives without medical advice.
Do not drive or operate machinery while sedated or impaired.
Seek medical help for breathing difficulties or unusual sleep-related behavior.
metabolism: Flavin-containing monooxygenases, particularly FMO3, have been reported to participate in metabolism. Specific metabolites and elimination routes are not yet well characterized.
